text_block_list.text: The three years I walked alongside Duramente in the Twinkle Series had come to an end.

Three intense, dazzling years... Through it all,
Duramente grew tremendously,
and—gained something truly irreplaceable.
That is—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer, good morning.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you
for today's training as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Now, regarding the opponent for our upcoming mock race...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, they are
the ones I want to ask."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, is that what you
heard this morning?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Zǎoshang, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san suddenly said,
"Let's run."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it is the usual, but...
I'm just happy you invited me."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You pulled off a spectacular victory in that Hong Kong race.
And taking down such an overwhelmingly powerful opponent made it a massive upset, too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure it was a painful journey until you arrived.
Yet you endured and overcame it... all thanks to your strength.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That is why
I want to run with you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Honestly, I'm just so very happy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"My answer is, of course, yes.
However, I'm not the only one, am I?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'll get ready and wait for you.
Good luck inviting the rest, ga yau la wo!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Let's assemble the best members we can.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... M-M-M-Me too...?!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You're making rapid progress right now, too.
Your strength is already well-proven.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
She tenaciously pushes through to the end
and strikes with a powerful late burst. We can't let our guard down around her.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
That is why
I want to run with you.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
………………—
U-Understood!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Because this is the greatest opportunity
to compete against none other than you..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I like that.
That look in your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Show me those eyes――the ones that watch me so vigilantly, waiting for their chance.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—The final person has already
been decided.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dura-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"It's rare for you to message me on LANE!
So, what did you need?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If it's helping out,
I'm ready anytime!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
It's a helper-type.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black.
Race against me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Since that day at the Japan Cup,
you've grown even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
To continue growing even after your Awakening has ended...
You possess the qualifications to be the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall
continue to defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: If you continue to grow stronger, then I shall surpass you even further.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I won't yield to other generations, either.
The one who will stand above you and become the strongest... is me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Dura-san...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Of course, I accept your challenge!
Though I'm giving those exact words right back to you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to get stronger
so that I won't lose to you, Dura-san!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
I see.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Well then—until the day of our showdown.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
There is something I've been thinking deeply about.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I am...
blessed beyond measure.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: —Ah, it's about to start! Duramente and the others' mock race!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Talk about a crazy stacked lineup~...!
Anyone could take the win here!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...Still, my vote's definitely on Duramente-senpai!
Because—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm the strongest,
I am 'the strongest'!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I'm ready.
choice_data_list: Everyone else said it's okay too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hm?
choice_data_list: ...Go and stand at the top of your rivals!
...Go and stand at the top of your rivals!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaah...!

Duramente will continue to run forward.
Alongside her irreplaceable rivals, towards a brilliant and shining future—
